Thanks for the context, Rachel. Julia — I pulled the invite token and logs for the link at https://coupa.com/invite/abcdef123456. Quick summary of what I'm seeing: the invite metadata contains the recipient email as julia.hart%2Bap@ridgefieldsupplies.com (URL-encoded plus). Our redirect logic decodes that value and hands it to the IdP relay. In a small number of IdPs (including some Okta setups) the incoming principal name is normalized in a way that doesn't match configured tenant lookup rules. That causes the 'No matching tenant found' message.

Workarounds (pick one):
- Julia: open the invite link in an incognito browser, when prompted by Okta choose 'Use another account' and manually type julia.hart@ridgefieldsupplies.com (no +ap).
- If you prefer, forward the invite to an alternate email (we can re-issue to julia.hart@ridgefieldsupplies.com directly).

I've opened a support ticket (INC-8921) to ensure we adjust normalization rules and add a safety check that maps common plus-address variants back to the canonical email for tenant lookup. I've attached the raw invite EML for ops debug.

Attachments: coupa-invite-raw-eml.txt (text/plain)
Related: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/INC-8921

Will follow up once the support change is staged.

—Ben
